== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Tal’gullour is a massive, planet-sized [[fortress]] and spacecraft that floats in space. Originally forged by [[Daruman]], also known as The [[Mad King|the Mad King]], from his original [[Iteration]], the vessel serves as his citadel and headquarters. The [[fortress]] is saturated with The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King's Authority{{!}}authority, making him its absolute master. It houses a population of approximately one billion individuals who maintain the vessel's shielding and manage its vast collection of rare, powerful, and unique treasures. The stronghold is noted for its splendor, rivaling even The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King's other fortresses in size and beauty. It contains various specialized areas, such as the [[Crystal Halls]] and several Treasure Halls. The [[fortress]] is heavily defended by ancient rune-circles and golden light attacks capable of warping space, which can be used to target enemies or seal off entire worlds. Additionally, the stronghold serves as the base for the [[Silent Servants]], a cult dedicated to the [[Silent King]].}}
